title: Delegation includes a handoff
hook: The helper saves work only after receiving the input.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a helper can start only once they have the input, so the handoff itself has to come first

misconception: Handing work to a helper saves time straight away.
objective: Include coordination as a prerequisite instead of ignoring it.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: The helper saves work only after receiving the input. What must precede the helper task here? Correct option: Handoff. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
